Problem Statement:
Write a program that calculates the absolute difference between the sum of digits at even and odd indices in a number. Indexing is 0-based. 
Input Description:
A single line containing a string of digits (number) 
Output Description:
A single integer: absolute difference between sums 
Sample Input:
573821 
Sample Output:
6
